dog.description_text: The sweetest little pups were surrendered to the shelter, all 11 of them, with their sweet mama, Rubirosa, a gorgeous, medium sized Flat Coated Retriever mix. Together with other rescues who stepped in to help, we were able to get this family to safety. Rescue City welcomed four of the puppies on October 10! Joe, Spumoni, Lucali, and Scarr have gone home in pairs to get lots of much needed love and care from their fosters as they continue to grow strong. At almost 2 months old, they’re just beginning their lives, and we can’t wait to help each find a loving forever home ready to raise a growing, learning little puppy. They have started their puppy vaccines and will be neutered when age appropriate. Ready to add one of these sweeties to your life? Apply at rescuecity.nyc/adopt.
